mechanisms.decisive_claim: Use r=ceil(log_2(q+2))+1 point-private primes and distinct nontrivial bipartitions to encode all q+1 incident lines with fixed point product and edge-private valuations.
mechanisms.kill_test: Verify the bipartition count, factor distinctness, and O((log q)^2) point bit cost.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: exact bipartition count and factor-separation proof

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Encode q+1 incidences by complementary exponent pairs on two point-private primes and obtain a smaller arithmetic host.
mechanisms.kill_test: Minimize the exponent range needed for q distinct fixed-product pairs and compare q log q with K.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: exponent range at least q and Omega(q log q) bit cost

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Reuse the same private-prime block at multiple projective points while varying only partitions.
mechanisms.kill_test: Place two reused points on their unique common line and test edge-private valuation propagation and global vertex distinctness.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: reused blocks collide on the unique common line

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Take q between 2^(floor(sqrt(K)/100)) and twice that value and arithmetically realize every projective line as a minimal equal-defect circuit in (2^K/32,2^K].
mechanisms.kill_test: Check prime supply, bit budget, padding, distinctness, minimality, and tau=q+1 for all sufficiently large K.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/OBSTRUCTION_ANALYSIS.md and evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: stretched projective-plane arithmetic host survives all first tests

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Replace the projective plane by an affine plane or a large partial plane to reduce arithmetic coding cost while retaining nu=1 and tau growing with q.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test parallel lines and deleted line classes for disjoint supports and exact blocking number.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: affine parallel classes force matching number greater than one

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Use a symmetric block design with larger covering number than a projective plane at the same point degree.
mechanisms.kill_test: Derive the Fisher-type parameter constraints and test whether pairwise block intersection and a certified arithmetic embedding coexist.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: exact one-point symmetric design reduces to projective-plane parameters

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Allocate every point-private prime below q^6 and prove that the point and private-vertex odd parts consume O((log q)^2) bits.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use the prime number theorem to compare pi(q^6) with (q^2+q+1)r and derive explicit large-K padding inequalities.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/OBSTRUCTION_ANALYSIS.md: q^6 prime supply and quadratic-logarithmic bit budget survive

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Replace prime blocks by pairwise-coprime smooth composite labels to improve q beyond exp(c sqrt K).
mechanisms.kill_test: Count required globally separating prime divisors and optimize the maximum logarithmic label size.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: composite labels do not reduce private-prime count or size

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Choose q=N^delta while retaining the subset-partition code and fixed-band embedding.
mechanisms.kill_test: Insert log q=Theta(K) into the point odd-part budget O((log q)^2) and test nonnegative padding exponents.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: polynomial q creates quadratic-in-K point bit cost

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Balance the common power-of-two discrepancy across the q+2 private vertices of each line with maximum decrement four.
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove 0<Delta<K+3(q+1)<4(q+2) once q>K and check the strict N/32 band.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: Delta bound and maximum decrement four proved

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Use several padding primes to support q polynomial in N despite the point odd-part budget.
mechanisms.kill_test: Separate padding freedom from the unchanged q-dependent point product and test whether any negative exponent is avoided.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: padding cannot shrink an oversized raw odd part

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Embed the power-of-two construction at 2^floor(log_2 N) into H_N and retain the target band and stretched-exponential bound for every large N.
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove the band inclusion and floor inequalities with explicit constants.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: dyadic band and monotonicity route survives

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Pack many disjoint projective-plane clusters to obtain a larger theorem while preserving the frozen single connected cluster properties.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute the matching number and pairwise intersection pattern of the union.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/MECHANISM_FALSIFICATION.md: cluster union violates matching-one and pairwise-intersection target
